title_as_printed: Densities of NaCl, Na2SO4, MgCl2, and MgSO4 Solutions from 35 to 95 C
pressure_note: not stated (vibrating-tube densimeter; atmospheric pressure presumed by authors but not stated)

value.what: density of solution minus density of pure water at the same temperature (Delta d = d - d0), printed as 10^3 Delta d; reference: water density from Kell

conversion_needs: value is a density difference: needs pure-water density at T (Kell) to get density; scale 1e-3 applied to the printed 10^3 Delta d
notes: Table I is printed as four column pairs per page with temperature sub-headings; blocks that continue into the next column are stacked into one block per (salt, temperature). The sheet for Na2SO4 is table_1_group2. Temperature scale IPTS-68 from the experimental section (HP quartz thermometer calibrated against Pt resistance thermometer, IPTS-68).
